core.notes:
The Changelog lists what this update brings
Sync can read another player's profile page for add-ons that show more on it, only in the tab you are looking at
The All Tweaks hover in the menu lists the Tweaks under On and Off headings, in alphabetical order and indented

modules.label: Dungeon Win rate
modules.notes:
Renamed to Dungeon Win rate (was Win rate), by Apoz and Weeble
After loading older entries for a range, the log scrolls back up to where you were, instead of staying at the bottom

modules.label: Grid Overlay
modules.notes:
Now by Apoz, Weeble and Spiritie
New Colours window (Colours menu in the overlay's right-click menu, or the new cog on the Presets list): themes Classic, Classic original (the old Grid Labels script), Colour-blind and Distinct; tones Classic, Vivid, Deep and Intense; Hybrid, Most used or Fixed colours; tile transparency from 0% (no fill) to 60%; a plain edge in your game theme's own border colour or a coloured one, each Full, Semi or Thin; bold and coloured text for names or numbers
Presets Default, AWOO+, Calm, Vibrant, Old script look and Alternative (the overlay as it was), plus up to three Custom looks on their own row that you can rename or delete (right-click one). Every change applies at once; a custom preset shows * until you press Save custom preset, and Reset goes back to its saved settings
Stats, resources, gold, XP, relics and drop rate keep their own natural colours; recipes get clearly different colours on each grid, and no colour is used twice on one grid
The right-click menu is shorter: Uniques and Cleaner tiles are two buttons each, Show/hide stats is on right-click of the grid
If you had Mod colours switched off, your grid stays without fill
Overlay tiles have crisp edges and are filled right into the corners; colours look the same whatever background the game uses
Hovering a tile with the overlay on lights it up clearly (a larger sculpture lights up whole), and the text on the tiles is sharper
The lines inside larger unique sculptures are all equally thin and crisp
No more short flicker of the tiles when the grid updates
A quiet note under the presets list names any unique sculpture missing from the grid (can be switched off in the Control Panel)
Cleaner tiles with the overlay off: the 🗿 sculpture heads are hidden (point at the middle of a tile for the game's pop-up), the tiles are less purple, and sculpture outlines are a little thicker
